units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 14">Pesik. R. s. 14</cite> [read:] <he>עלה עליה עול עיניה מתחלפות והיא פוֹזֶלֶת ומסתכלת בעול</he> once she has had a yoke on, her eyes change (she squints), and she turns her head and attempts to look at the yoke (Tanḥ. ed. Bub., Ḥuck. 3 <he>עיניה מפלבלות</he>).

senses.gloss: to be twisted. Pesik. R. l. c. ועוד עינים מן העול שנ׳ (not שנפלו) and they had another evidence from the yoke (that had just been taken off her) the rope of which appeared twisted.
